Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the heads up and the proposed cadence. We can accommodate a three-part remittance schedule for INV-8873. Proposed confirmation below so AP has a single reference:

- Tranche 1: 40% — 2026-03-10 — ACH or card accepted
- Tranche 2: 40% — 2026-03-20 — ACH preferred (will accept wire if needed)
- Tranche 3: 20% — 2026-03-31 — ACH

Notes on mechanics:
- ACH pre-authorization: Not strictly required from our side for inbound ACH, but your bank may request ACH prenote/verification. If your AP team needs a pre-auth routing reference, I’ve attached a short bank_instructions.txt that lists our account stub and the required remittance memo (INV-8873 / Veridian).
- Card fees: If Veridian pays by corporate card, we’ll receive the gross amount; Redwood does not add additional convenience fees, but we do record the transaction for reconciliation. If you require a net-amount adjustment (to cover card surcharge), please propose the amount and we’ll escalate.
- VAT: attaching the VAT breakdown and our completed W-9 for your records.

Attachments: Invoice_8873.pdf (original), VAT_breakdown_INV-8873.xlsx (inline summary below), W9_redwood.pdf, bank_instructions.txt

Quick ask: Please confirm acceptance of the dates and whether the first tranche will be ACH or card so I can flag treasury. If card, let me know billing descriptor or last four digits of the card for reconciliation.

Best,

Grace —

Appreciate the quick turn. Two quick clarifications from treasury:
1) For the ACH — can you provide the ACH routing + account type in the bank_instructions.txt rather than a stub? Our bank requires full routing/account and payee name to push the first tranche on 03/10. If you prefer not to include full account details in email, we can take a secure transfer via your cloud payment portal or accept a signed copy via DocuSign.
2) For the card option — they need to know if Redwood will capture the full amount immediately and then credit later (we prefer to avoid credits). If you accept card, please confirm whether a separate invoice will be issued for the card transaction (so we can map refunds or fees).

If you can either: (A) update bank_instructions.txt with full ACH routing, or (B) send a DocuSign link to capture payment instructions securely, we’ll schedule the first tranche for 03/10.

Sarah

Hi Sarah — looping in briefly from finance to confirm we’re OK with the schedule and to offer the secure DocuSign flow Ben Carter (Finance Lead) here.

Grace has approved the three-part schedule. For security we prefer sharing full account details via DocuSign or our secure payments portal. Grace — can you open a DocuSign envelope with the bank details and an ACH authorization field and share the link back to ap@veridian.tech? We’ll mark the envelope as time-limited for the first-tranche cutoff (03/09 EOD).

Regarding card capture: Redwood will process the card charge as a normal transaction and will not auto-issue a refund unless requested. We do not issue a separate invoice for card fees; the original invoice remains the record. If Veridian needs us to net out card-processing fees, we can put that on a separate credit memo but would prefer ACH for cleaner reconciliation.
